name: Kami Torii Foxfire Runner
loreTies: A shrine-bound trickster spirit that defends contracts and boundaries; hostile only when a mission violates local spirit law.
Flanks the Titan and baits wasted AoE.
source culture humans later copied as Japanese myth and Shinto shrine lore
shortBackstory: Kami Torii Foxfire Runner is a lore-faithful Kami run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Kami Torii Foxfire Runner belongs to The Sacred Kingdoms and exists to express Kami law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Flanks the Titan and baits wasted AoE.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Vermilion mask, foxfire tails, lacquer-black footguards, paper seal streamers. Abilities — Foxfire Dash, Mirror Feint, Seal Nip — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Titan-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
